title: Se Compran Libros --- The Verb Tells On Itself
label: ch:se-agreement
canDo: I can make the verb agree with the thing, and say why it does.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C52-se-venden: produce se compran libros and read it as if se still meant themselves.
payoff.note: The agreement is the fossil: books buy themselves. The impersonal grew out of the reflexive rather than being borrowed from anywhere.
